# Noémia

> Noémia is a restaurant in Lisbon, Portugal, serving Portuguese tapas and wines, with live fado performances several nights a week.

- Address: R. do Duque, 21, 1200-158 Lisboa, Portugal
- Phone: +351 210 509 605
- Email: noemia.contacto@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/noemia_restaurante/
- Price range: €€ (moderate)
- Cuisine: Portuguese tapas and wine
- Opening hours: Thursday 18:00–23:00; Friday to Monday 19:00–23:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday
- Live fado: every 30 minutes, Friday to Monday, 20:00–23:00, performed by the house group (Grupo da Casa)
- Reservations: https://reserve.dish.co/347019
